findings.evidence: Lines 128 and 155 impose the four extra instances solely because the proof routes through `inversions_ofIdx`; nonidentity follows directly from the reflection action on its defining root together with `P.pairing_same i = 2` and characteristic zero, without a base or finite/crystallographic/reduced assumptions.
findings.fix: Move/prove the general lemma near `ofIdx_mul_self` with signature `theorem ofIdx_ne_one (i : ι) : RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx P i ≠ 1` under only `[CharZero R]`, then use it directly in the rank-two theorem.
findings.issue: `RootPairing.weylGroup.ofIdx_ne_one` unnecessarily requires `[Finite ι] [IsDomain R] [P.IsCrystallographic] [P.IsReduced]`, a base, and support membership, although every simple reflection is nonidentity in any root pairing over a characteristic-zero ring.

summary: The new simple-reflection nonidentity API is stated with unnecessary finite-type hypotheses and dependence on a base.
